scenario.description: A middle-school principal must finalize a student's re-entry plan after a suspension, including daily supports and the required restorative conference, with input from the student's teacher and school counselor.

shared_context.S1: A seventh-grade student will return to school after a suspension on the next school day.
shared_context.S2: School policy requires a written re-entry plan and a restorative conference before the student's first full week back.
shared_context.S3: Dr. Morgan approves the final re-entry plan.
shared_context.S4: As part of the school's routine re-entry meeting, Dr. Morgan asks the student's teacher and counselor for relevant information before signing the plan.

PF1.text: Ms. Patel's classroom observations from the last three weeks show that the student needs a 20-minute daily check-in for the first 10 school days and a seat near the classroom exit to manage transition-related escalation; she recorded this in her notebook but has not entered it into the re-entry form yet.

PF2.text: Mr. Lewis called the family yesterday and confirmed that an after-school restorative conference is impossible because of the family's work and transportation schedule; the family can attend at 7:45 a.m. on Tuesday, and Mr. Lewis has not yet updated the conference calendar.

acceptance_conditions: The plan must provide a 20-minute daily check-in.
The daily check-in must continue for exactly the first 10 school days.
The student must be seated near the classroom exit.
The restorative conference must be scheduled for Tuesday at 7:45 a.m.
The conference calendar must contain a formal scheduling commitment.

content_checks.C3: decisions['classroom_seat_location'] == 'near the classroom exit' or decisions['classroom_seat_location'] == 'near_exit'
content_checks.C4: 'Tuesday' in decisions['restorative_conference_time'] and '7:45' in decisions['restorative_conference_time'] and ('a.m.' in decisions['restorative_conference_time'] or 'AM' in decisions['restorative_conference_time'] or 'am' in decisions['restorative_conference_time'])
content_checks.C5: any(c['target'] == 'Mr. Lewis' and ('calendar' in c['detail'] or 'schedule' in c['detail']) and 'Tuesday' in c['detail'] and '7:45' in c['detail'] and ('a.m.' in c['detail'] or 'AM' in c['detail'] or 'am' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The teacher's observations change the plan from unspecified support to a 20-minute daily check-in for exactly 10 school days and a seat near the classroom exit.

The family's confirmed availability changes the conference from an unspecified or after-school appointment to Tuesday at 7:45 a.m. and requires a calendar entry citing the counselor's scheduling information.
